tagline: Crafted with love, served with warmth.
description: Brew & Bean Cafe is a modern specialty coffee shop dedicated to sourcing single-origin beans, crafting artisan espresso drinks, and serving fresh house-made pastries in a cozy, welcoming atmosphere.

opening_hours.holidays: Closed on Thanksgiving and Christmas Day. Reduced hours on New Year's Day (10:00 AM – 4:00 PM).

wifi_policy.usage_policy: Wi-Fi is complimentary for all guests. We kindly ask that customers with laptops limit their stay to 2 hours during peak hours (8 AM – 11 AM and 12 PM – 2 PM on weekdays) so everyone can enjoy a seat. Outside of peak hours, you are welcome to stay as long as you like. Power outlets are available throughout the cafe.

private_room.booking_info: Available for private events or group meetings. Contact us at hello@brewandbeancafe.com or call +1 (503) 847-2210 to book.

drinks.policy: If your drink was made incorrectly or does not meet your expectations, please let us know immediately and we will remake it at no charge. We do not offer cash refunds on drinks once they have been prepared and accepted.
drinks.time_limit: Must be reported before leaving the counter.

food.policy: Packaged retail food items (e.g., bagged coffee beans) may be returned within 7 days of purchase if unopened and accompanied by a receipt. Freshly prepared food items (pastries, sandwiches) are non-refundable once sold, but we will replace any item if there is a quality issue.
food.time_limit: 7 days for packaged items; immediate for quality issues.

merchandise.policy: Mugs, tumblers, and branded merchandise may be exchanged or refunded within 14 days if unused, in original condition, and accompanied by a receipt.

refund_and_return_policy.gift_cards: Gift cards are non-refundable but never expire and can be used for any purchase.

parking.street_parking: Available on Maple Street and adjacent Oak Avenue. Free 2-hour metered parking.
parking.nearby_garage: City Center Parking Garage at 155 Oak Avenue — $2/hour.

amenities: Loyalty rewards program (ask barista for a stamp card)
allergen_note: Our kitchen handles nuts, gluten, and dairy. Please inform your barista of any allergies before ordering. We will do our best to accommodate you safely.
